'''Gold Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] consisting of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The squadron most famously fought at both the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==History==
===Aboard ''Independence''===
A Gold Squadron was stationed aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] during the build up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Many members were transferred to [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]] and reassigned to different squadrons for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] assault.<ref name="X-WingGuide" />

===Battle of Yavin===
[[File:Mobilize_the_Squadrons_TCGcore.png|thumb|left|250px|Gold Squadron and Red Squadron mobilize to assault the Death Star.]]
During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Gold Squadron under the command of [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]] was tasked with attacking the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] while [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] flew cover.<ref name="Episode IV" /> The entire squadron was wiped out except for [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], after which Red Squadron made the final successful trench run.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

*Gold Leader&mdash;[[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]]<ref name="Episode IV" />
*Gold Two&mdash;[[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]]<ref name="Episode IV" />
*Gold Three&mdash;[[Ryle Torsyn/Legends|Ryle Torsyn]]<ref name="CCGRT">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Ryle Torsyn}}</ref>
*Gold Four&mdash;[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lepira/Legends|Lepira]]<ref name="CCGLL">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Lepira}}</ref>
*Gold Five&mdash;[[Davish Krail/Legends|Davish "Pops" Krail]]<ref name="Episode IV" />
*Gold Six&mdash;[[Hol Okand/Legends|Hol Okand]]<ref name="CCGHO">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Hol Okand}}</ref>
*Gold Seven&mdash;[[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan "Lucky" Farlander]]<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]''</ref>

===After Yavin===
In the months following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] led a Gold Squadron of Y-wings working closely with Rogue Squadron on a number of bombing raids, including the [[Liberation of Gerrard V]].<ref name="SWRS" />

Following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], several Gold Squadron Y-wings attempted to attack an Imperial space station, [[Outpost D-34]], but were defeated by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and several [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] squadrons.<ref name="TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>

A Gold Squadron flying [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] fighters was stationed aboard the cruiser [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] during operations against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]].<ref name="XvsT">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''</ref>

In the lead up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], a '''Gold Group''' consisting of multiple starfighter types was posted to the cruiser [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']], and later, the ''Independence''.<ref name="XWA" />

===Battle of Endor===
Gold Squadron's Y-wings<ref name="XWA" /> fought in the Battle of Endor&mdash;in which it was also referred to as Gold Group and as '''Gold Wing'''<ref name="CSWEGW">{{CSWECite|I|352|Gold Wing}}</ref>&mdash;under the command of General [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] piloting the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> Assigned the task of destroying the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]],<ref name="CSWEGW" /> the [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] was hit hard early in the engagement, with its surviving pilots&mdash;including "[[Gold Wing]]"&mdash;following the ''Falcon'' into the Death Star's superstructure. Through attrition and attempts to draw away the pursuing [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]], the number of Rebel craft inside the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] dwindled until only the ''Falcon'', "Gold Wing", and [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] remained. While "Gold Wing" was shot down by an Imperial fighter, Calrissian was able to enter the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], firing on it with Antilles and causing the destruction of the second Death Star.<ref name="ROTJ Novelization">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>

*Gold Leader - Lando Calrissian with [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]]<ref name="XWA" /> (flying the ''Millennium Falcon'')<ref name="Episode VI" />
*Gold Wing - Unidentified pilot

===After Endor===
The day after the victory at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the squadron&mdash;without Calrissian&mdash;joined the Alliance's [[Bakura task force]], combatting the [[Bakura/Legends|planet's]] [[Invasion of Bakura|invasion]] by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] in response to an Imperial distress message. Arriving in-system to reinforce Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Pter Thanas]], Gold Squadron joined Rogue Squadron in an attack on a Ssi-ruuvi [[Wurrif-class light cruiser|''Wurrif''-class light cruiser]].<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

Gold Squadron continued to serve in the newly-formed [[Alliance of Free Planets]], fighting [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] forces in the [[Second Battle of Endor]], with Calrissian flying as Gold Leader in the ''[[Cobra]]''.<ref name="MC100" /> It later engaged the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] forces in the [[Battle of Saijo]], destroying half of their [[Tof starfighter]]s.<ref name="MC107">[[Star Wars (1977) 107|''Star Wars'' (1977) 107]]</ref>
